Package io.github.projectunified.valuevenue.bukkit

Class BukkitPlayerSource<K>

java.lang.Object
io.github.projectunified.valuevenue.bukkit.BukkitPlayerSource<K>
Type Parameters:
K - type of the key
All Implemented Interfaces:
ValueSource<K,org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer>, Function<K,List<org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer>>
public class BukkitPlayerSource<K> extends Object implements ValueSource<K,org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer>
A ValueSource whose values are the players of the server.

<key> resolves to the name of the player, and <key>_<variable> is delegated to replaceVariable(String, OfflinePlayer), which returns null by default. Override it to resolve the player variables of the owner, calling the default for the rest.

Whether a player is active is decided by its own filter, which is refreshed by the update of the generator. Which players a key may see is decided by the key filter, which gets both the player and the key, so the source does not have to know what a key is.
